description: This file contains implementation of big number division functions, including BN_div and BN_mod, for cryptographic operations in OpenSSL. It includes low-level division algorithms, macros, and conditional assembly optimizations.

methods.name: BN_div
methods.description: Performs division of big numbers, returning quotient and remainder.

methods.name: BN_mod
methods.description: Calculates the modulus of big numbers, using BN_div internally.
